
### distributing Bellman-Ford outline (1)  {.smaller}


* [on each node A run:]{.fragment fragment-index=1 .custom .myem-only}
* repeatedly:
* for each link <em>from A</em> (going to B, distance c) 

   * for each node X:
   * if $c + d(B, X) < d(A, X)$, <br>
   * then $d(A,X) \leftarrow c+d(B,X)$, $p(A,X) = B$
 
<hr class="vspace" />
* [on node A: track $d(A, X)$, $p(A, X)$]{.fragment fragment-index=2 .custom .myem-only}
* [node A needs to get $d(B, X)$ to run algorithm]{.fragment fragment-index=3 .custom .myem-only}
